With this API method, you can do anything from sending a basic message to one person, all the way to sending customized messages to thousands of recipients in one go. It comes with a range of useful features like transliteration, scheduling, and tracking in a unified way.\

info.name: Send SMS message over query parameters

params.name: bulkId
params.description: Unique ID assigned to the request if messaging multiple recipients or sending multiple messages via a single API request.

params.name: from
params.description: The sender ID which can be alphanumeric or numeric (e.g., `CompanyName`).

params.name: to
params.description: List of message recipients.

params.name: text
params.description: Content of the message being sent.

params.name: flash
params.description: Sends a [flash SMS](https://www.infobip.com/docs/sms/message-types#flash-sms) if set to true.

params.name: transliteration
params.description: Conversion of a message text from one script to another.

params.name: languageCode
params.description: Code for language character set of a message content.

params.name: intermediateReport
params.description: Use a [real-time intermediate delivery report](#channels/sms/receive-outbound-sms-message-report-v3) that will be sent on your callback server.

params.name: notifyUrl
params.description: The URL on your call back server on to which a delivery report will be sent.

params.name: notifyContentType
params.description: Preferred delivery report content type, `application/json` or `application/xml`.

params.name: callbackData
params.description: Additional data that can be used for identifying, managing, or monitoring a message. Data included here will also be automatically included in the message [Delivery Report](#channels/sms/get-outbound-sms-message-delivery-reports-v3). The maximum value is 4000 characters.

params.name: validityPeriod
params.description: The message validity period in minutes. When the period expires, it will not be allowed for the message to be sent. Validity period longer than 48h is not supported. Any bigger value will automatically default back to `2880`.

params.name: sendAt
params.description: Date and time when the message is to be sent. Used for [scheduled SMS](#channels/sms/get-scheduled-sms-messages). Has the following format: `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ`. Must be sooner than 180 days from now.

params.name: includeSmsCountInResponse
params.description: Set to true to return smsCount in the response. Default is false. smsCount is the total count of SMS submitted in the request. SMS messages have a character limit and messages longer than that limit will be split into multiple SMS and reflected in the total count of SMS submitted.

params.name: trackingUrl
params.description: The URL of your callback server on to which the Click report will be sent.

params.name: trackingType
params.description: Sets a custom conversion type naming convention, e.g. ONE_TIME_PIN, SOCIAL_INVITES, etc.

params.name: indiaDltContentTemplateId
params.description: The ID of your registered DLT (Distributed Ledger Technology) content template.

params.name: indiaDltPrincipalEntityId
params.description: Your DLT (Distributed Ledger Technology) entity id.

params.name: indiaDltTelemarketerId
params.description: Your assigned Telemarketer ID. (required for Aggregators)

params.name: turkeyIysBrandCode
params.description: Brand code is an ID of the company based on a company VAT number. If not provided in request, default value is used from your Infobip account.

params.name: turkeyIysRecipientType
params.description: Recipient Type must be TACIR or BIREYSEL

params.name: southKoreaResellerCode
params.description: Reseller identification code: 9-digit registration number in the business registration certificate for South Korea. Resellers should submit this when sending.

params.name: southKoreaTitle
params.description: Title of the message.

items.docs:
Use this endpoint to inform the Infobip platform about the successful conversion on your side. Infobip will use this information to monitor SMS performance and provide you with better service. To enable Conversion Tracking, set up the “tracking” object to “SMS” when [sending a message](https://www.infobip.com/docs/api/channels/sms/sms-messaging/outbound-sms) over HTTP API.
For more information, see: [Tracking Conversion](https://www.infobip.com/docs/sms/api#track-conversion).

If you are unable to receive incoming SMS to the endpoint of your choice in real-time, you can use this API call to fetch messages. Each request will return a batch of received messages, only once. The API request will only return new messages that arrived since the last API request. To use this method, you’d need to:
  1. Buy a number capable of receiving SMS traffic.
  2. Specify a forwarding end

items.docs: If you are unable to receive real-time message delivery reports towards your endpoint for various reasons, we offer you an API method to fetch batches of message reports to confirm whether specific messages have been delivered. Each request towards this endpoint returns batches of the latest message reports. The API returns each report only once. If the message status changes again after retrieval, the endpoint returns a new report for the updated status on the next request.

params.name: mcc
params.description: Mobile Country Code.

params.name: mnc
params.description: Mobile Network Code. Mobile Country Code is required if this property is used.

params.name: sender
params.description: The sender ID which can be alphanumeric or numeric.

params.name: destination
params.description: Message destination address.

params.name: bulkId
params.description: Unique ID assigned to the request if messaging multiple recipients or sending multiple messages via a single API request. May contain multiple comma-separated values. Maximum length 2048 characters.

params.name: messageId
params.description: Unique message ID for which a log is requested. May contain multiple comma-separated values. Maximum length 2048 characters.

params.name: sentSince
params.description: The logs will only include messages sent after this date. Use it alongside sentUntil to specify a time range for the logs, but only up to the maximum limit of 1000 logs per call. Has the following format: yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ.

params.name: sentUntil
params.description: The logs will only include messages sent before this date. Use it alongside sentSince to specify a time range for the logs, but only up to the maximum limit of 1000 logs per call. Has the following format: yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of messages to include in logs. If not set, the latest 50 records are returned. Maximum limit value is 1000 and you can only access logs for the last 48h.

params.name: entityId
params.description: Entity id used to send the message. For more details, see our [documentation](https://www.infobip.com/docs/cpaas-x/application-and-entity-management).

params.name: applicationId
params.description: Application id used to send the message. For more details, see our [documentation](https://www.infobip.com/docs/cpaas-x/application-and-entity-management).

params.name: campaignReferenceId
params.description: ID of a campaign that was sent in the message. May contain multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: useCursor
params.description: Flag used to enable cursor-based pagination. When set to true, the system will use the cursor to fetch the next set of logs.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Value which represents the current position in the data set. For the first request, this field shouldn't be defined. In subsequent requests, use the `nextCursor` value returned from the previous response to continue fetching data.

items.docs: Use this method to obtain the logs associated with outbound messages. The available logs are limited to those generated in the last 48 hours, and you can retrieve a maximum of only 1000 logs per call. See [message delivery reports](#channels/sms/get-outbound-sms-message-delivery-reports-v3) if your use case is to verify message delivery.
